verdict.stance: Neutral / Chrome-Hedged PGM Producer Ramp-Up (B Stable S&P)
verdict.summary: Tharisa doubled H1 FY26 EBITDA to $104.3m on $359.4m revenue (+28% YoY) before ending FY26 (Sep-26) with $123.6m cash and $462.8m total debt ($51.0m net debt) as underground and Karo Platinum capex accelerated. Chrome co-product revenues provide vital cyclical insulation.

positives: Co-product chrome & PGM model at Tharisa Mine (South Africa) provides counter-cyclical margin resilience (H1 FY26 rev $359.4m, NPAT $46.6m).
FY26 production met guidance (153.7 koz PGMs, >1.56 Mt chrome concentrate).
Sep 2026 oversubscribed $300m 11.00% 2031 Nordic bond secures project funding (held in escrow subject to release conditions).
negatives: Heavy leverage step-up from $300m 11.00% bond alongside Karo Platinum (Zimbabwe) capex & jurisdictional risk.
Multi-year transition of flagship Tharisa Mine from open-pit to underground raises execution & capex risk.
High volatility in metallurgical chrome and PGM basket prices.
